mapper.select: SELECT NVL(POINT_BALANCE, 0) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET POINT_BALANCE = #{newBalance} WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_POINT (POINT_ID, MEMBER_NO, POINT_TYPE, POINT_AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, REASON_CD, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, REG_DATE) VALUES ((SELECT NVL(MAX(POINT_ID),0)+1 FROM TB_POINT), #{memberNo}, 'EARN', #{pointAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{reasonCd}, #{refType}, #{refId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select:
SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.ORDER_NO, o.ORDER_DATE, o.ORDER_STATUS, o.PAY_AMOUNT, o.TOTAL_AMOUNT, o.DELIVERY_FEE, o.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, o.POINT_USED, o.RECV_NAME, o.RECV_PHONE, o.ZIP_CODE, o.ADDR1, o.ADDR2, o.DELIVERY_MEMO, m.NICKNAME AS ORDERER_NAME, b.BIZ_NAME, d.COURIER_NAME, d.COURIER_CODE, d.TRACKING_NO, d.READY_AT, d.SHIPPING_AT, d.DELIVERED_AT, o.CLAIM_STATUS, o.CANCEL_REASON, o.REFUND_AMOUNT, o.REQUESTED_AT, o.CONFIRM_YN, pay.TOSS_ORDER_ID AS ORDER_GROUP_ID
FROM TB_ORDER o JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_NO = o.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_BUSINESS b ON b.BIZ_NO = o.BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ORDER_DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_PAYMENT pay ON pay.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID WHERE o.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND o.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}

SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.ORDER_NO, o.ORDER_DATE, o.ORDER_STATUS, o.PAY_AMOUNT, o.TOTAL_AMOUNT, o.DELIVERY_FEE, o.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, o.POINT_USED, o.RECV_NAME, o.RECV_PHONE, o.ZIP_CODE, o.ADDR1, o.ADDR2, o.DELIVERY_MEMO, m.NICKNAME AS ORDERER_NAME, b.BIZ_NAME, d.COURIER_NAME, d.COURIER_CODE, d.TRACKING_NO, d.READY_AT, d.SHIPPING_AT, d.DELIVERED_AT, o.CLAIM_STATUS, o.CANCEL_REASON, o.REFUND_AMOUNT, o.REQUESTED_AT, o.CONFIRM_YN, pay.TOSS_ORDER_ID AS ORDER_GROUP_ID
FROM TB_ORDER o JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_NO = o.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_BUSINESS b ON b.BIZ_NO = o.BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ORDER_DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN TB_PAYMENT pay ON pay.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID WHERE pay.TOSS_ORDER_ID = #{groupId} AND o.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY o.ORDER_ID ASC
SELECT M.MEMBER_NO FROM TB_ORDER O JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = O.BIZ_NO JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = B.BIZ_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ORDER SET CLAIM_TYPE = 'CANCEL', CLAIM_STATUS = 'PENDING', CANCEL_REASON = #{reason}, REQUESTED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('PAID', 'READY') AND CLAIM_STATUS IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID, oi.PRODUCT_ID, oi.PRODUCT_NAME, oi.OPTION_COLOR, oi.OPTION_SIZE, oi.QTY, oi.TOTAL_PRICE, oi.CONFIRMED_AT, oi.RETURN_STATUS_CD, oi.RETURN_REASON_CD, oi.CLAIM_REASON, oi.CONFIRM_HOLD_YN, oi.REFUND_AMOUNT, oi.RETURN_FEE_AMOUNT, oi.RETURN_REJECT_REASON, f.FILE_URL AS THUMBNAIL_URL, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_REVIEW r WHERE r.ORDER_ITEM_ID = oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS REVIEWED FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REF_ID, FILE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY REF_ID ORDER BY FILE_ID) AS RN FROM TB_FILE WHERE REF_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' ) f ON f.REF_ID = oi.PRODUCT_ID AND f.RN = 1 WHERE oi.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID
SELECT REVIEW_ID FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE ORDER_ITEM_ID = #{orderItemId} AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert:
SELECT NVL(MAX(REVIEW_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TB_REVIEW
INSERT INTO TB_REVIEW (REVIEW_ID, REVIEW_TYPE, TARGET_ID, MEMBER_NO, ORDER_ITEM_ID, RATING, CONTENT, REG_DATE) SELECT #{reviewId}, 'PRODUCT', oi.PRODUCT_ID, #{memberNo}, oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID, #{rating}, #{content}, SYSDATE FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi JOIN TB_ORDER o ON o.ORDER_ID = oi.ORDER_ID WHERE oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID = #{orderItemId} AND o.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND oi.CONFIRMED_AT IS NOT NULL AND NVL(oi.RETURN_STATUS_CD, 'NONE') NOT IN ('REQUESTED', 'RETURNING', 'DONE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_REVIEW r WHERE r.ORDER_ITEM_ID = oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID)
mapper.select: SELECT o.ORDER_ID AS ORDER_ID, o.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO FROM TB_ORDER o JOIN TB_ORDER_DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID WHERE o.ORDER_STATUS = 'DONE' AND d.DELIVERED_AT IS NOT NULL AND d.DELIVERED_AT <= SYSDATE - 7 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi WHERE oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID AND oi.CONFIRMED_AT IS NULL AND NVL(oi.RETURN_STATUS_CD, 'NONE') NOT IN ('REQUESTED', 'RETURNING', 'DONE') )

SELECT oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID, oi.PRODUCT_ID, oi.PRODUCT_NAME, oi.OPTION_COLOR, oi.OPTION_SIZE, oi.QTY, oi.TOTAL_PRICE, oi.CONFIRMED_AT, oi.RETURN_STATUS_CD, oi.RETURN_REASON_CD, oi.CLAIM_REASON, oi.CONFIRM_HOLD_YN, oi.REFUND_AMOUNT, oi.RETURN_FEE_AMOUNT, oi.RETURN_REJECT_REASON, f.FILE_URL AS THUMBNAIL_URL, 0 AS REVIEWED FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi JOIN TB_ORDER o ON o.ORDER_ID = oi.ORDER_ID JOIN TB_ORDER_DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REF_ID, FILE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY REF_ID ORDER BY FILE_ID) AS RN FROM TB_FILE WHERE REF_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' ) f ON f.REF_ID = oi.PRODUCT_ID AND f.RN = 1 WHERE oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID = #{orderItemId} AND o.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('SHIPPING', 'DONE') AND oi.CONFIRMED_AT IS NULL AND d.TRACKING_NO IS NOT NULL AND NVL(oi.RETURN_STATUS_CD, 'NONE') NOT IN ('REQUESTED', 'RETURNING', 'DONE')
SELECT NVL(SUM(oi.TOTAL_PRICE), 0) FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi WHERE oi.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND oi.CONFIRMED_AT IS NULL AND NVL(oi.RETURN_STATUS_CD, 'NONE') NOT IN ('REQUESTED', 'RETURNING', 'DONE')
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ORDER_ITEM SET RETURN_STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED', RETURN_REASON_CD = #{returnReasonCd}, CLAIM_REASON = #{claimReason}, RETURN_FEE_PAYER = #{returnFeePayer}, RETURN_FEE_AMOUNT = #{returnFeeAmount}, CONFIRM_HOLD_YN = 'Y', RETURN_REQUESTED_AT = SYSDATE, RETURN_APPROVED_AT = NULL, RETURN_REJECTED_AT = NULL, RETURN_DONE_AT = NULL, RETURN_REJECT_REASON = NULL, REFUND_AMOUNT = NULL WHERE ORDER_ITEM_ID = #{orderItemId} AND CONFIRMED_AT IS NULL AND NVL(RETURN_STATUS_CD, 'NONE') NOT IN ('REQUESTED', 'RETURNING', 'DONE')
mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_NO FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN TB_ORDER O ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = O.BIZ_NO JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = B.BIZ_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID = #{orderItemId}
SELECT O.ORDER_NO FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN TB_ORDER O ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID = #{orderItemId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ORDER_ITEM SET CONFIRMED_AT = SYSDATE, CONFIRM_HOLD_YN = 'N' WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND CONFIRMED_AT IS NULL AND NVL(RETURN_STATUS_CD, 'NONE') NOT IN ('REQUESTED', 'RETURNING', 'DONE')
mapper.select: SELECT oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID, oi.PRODUCT_ID, oi.PRODUCT_NAME, oi.OPTION_COLOR, oi.OPTION_SIZE, oi.QTY, oi.TOTAL_PRICE, oi.RETURN_STATUS_CD, oi.RETURN_REASON_CD, oi.CLAIM_REASON, oi.CONFIRM_HOLD_YN, oi.REFUND_AMOUNT, oi.RETURN_FEE_AMOUNT, oi.RETURN_REJECT_REASON, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(500)) AS THUMBNAIL_URL, 0 AS REVIEWED FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi JOIN TB_ORDER o ON o.ORDER_ID = oi.ORDER_ID WHERE o.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND oi.CONFIRMED_AT IS NOT NULL AND NVL(oi.RETURN_STATUS_CD, 'NONE') NOT IN ('REQUESTED', 'RETURNING', 'DONE') AND o.ORDER_STATUS <> 'CANCEL' ORDER BY oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID
